reason: 一次本文を確認したが、LLM inference efficiencyとの接続、効果の一般性または技術的な新規性が弱く、理由を付してborderlineに残す。This survey maps speech foundation models and LLMs for speech translation, datasets, architectures and open problems. It is useful background but does not propose/test speculative decoding or a serving optimization.
title: Speech Translation with Speech Foundation Models and Large Language Models: What is There and What is Missing?
